Method of Attack: Malware downloader that gathers system information and sends it to C&C server
Ability to download and run other binaries
Quits execution if user is not administrator

Malicious CCleaner installer signed with valid Avast digital certificate
Indicators of Compromise: CCleaner version 5.33.6162 and CCleaner Cloud version 1.07.3191 containing Floxif malware
